value_rationale: [I] Incorporated act requires State consent and retains officers. No union honour: these are Confederate provisional forces. Mere fort destination does not warrant glory/caution tags.
[I] Text expressly prepares resistance to Washington coercion. The autonomy reading concerns that stated purpose, not a governor answer; incorporated State appointments remain explicit.
[I] Own text says hostile Washington purpose and incorporates the earlier resistance call. Do not turn readiness into a glory demand.

[I] Minimal own-text mapping: a regiment to a destination alone supplies no universal union/duty/glory tag. State officer rights belong to the incorporated law and can be represented structurally without presuming every clause is a value reward.

[I] The KY letter explicitly opposes US coercion of Confederate States and preserves State-law unit appointments; adapted AR/NC/TN letters share its terms. No actor-specific legality penalty invented.
[I] Explicit protection of the Mississippi Valley supports order. No named appointment or arms clause permits an autonomy offence or equipment bar here.
[I] Own text stresses precaution and public safety; federal assembly and field appointment displace State control. No union reward and no promise to retain State brigade commanders.
[I] Purpose is completing the precautionary corps. No explicit cavalry field-appointment clause supports automatically copying infantry autonomy offence.
[I] Own text explicitly preserves selection of regimental officers. Federal staff appointment alone is not treated as identical to reserve field appointments; no inferred union honour.

[I] Proclamation expressly preserves National Union and executes its laws; armed repossession overrides claimed State control of seized federal property. Autonomy offence is this objective [I], not a claim that all governors disputed their own appointments. Peaceful-citizen restraint is retained structurally; no inferred abolition or slavery value.

[I] Proclamation explicitly preserves Union and suppresses insurrection. National coercive purpose persists; unit officer State appointment is preserved structurally rather than cancelling the objective.
[I] Accepted tender text contains no explicit Union preservation/objective or officer-rights clause; leave value arrays empty rather than borrow from neighbouring proclamation or later answer.
[I] Administrative regular organisation carries no explicit state appointment deprivation or named value beyond referenced proclamation. Avoid new temperament/loyalty inference.
[I] Enclosed GO15 explicitly enforces laws/suppresses insurrection. Scope is incorporated plan, not the governor response. No automatic career/glory tag for officer vacancies.
[I] Express GO15incorporation imports its enforcement/suppression purpose. Preserve specified colonel regiments/four gubernatorial designations structurally; no fit to Morton later answer.
[I] State organisation text supports officer-selection procedure; no explicit national political purpose in GO78 beyond US service. Do not borrow Union/duty reward solely to fit Morgan.
[I] Minimal acceptance has no additional named value; no arms-quantity assumption or actor-conditioned offence.
